title: Digital Etch-A-Sketch
tagline: A portable, battery-powered drawing toy built around STM32 and rotary encoders.
description: The Digital Etch-A-Sketch is a portable recreation of the classic drawing toy. It uses an STM32 microcontroller, a 3.5-inch TFT display, and rotary encoders so the user can draw, erase, and adjust settings from a handheld device. The project emphasizes tactile controls, low-power operation, and a compact embedded firmware architecture.
